summary: The current canonical source has no client/server RemoteEvent or RemoteFunction authority path. Any source-only two-client backfill must therefore avoid deriving distinct-client identity or PASS from client-supplied fields: server-side Player identity must bind each observation to the caller, request correlation must be server-established, and duplicate/stale/cross-request observations must fail closed before comparison.
evidence: Canonical client bootstrap currently only reads protocol version and prints foundation status; it does not author canonical Physics Lab state.
Repository search on canonical main finds no RemoteEvent/RemoteFunction Physics Lab authority path to preserve or extend.
HG151-TWOCLIENT requires a real server plus two distinct client identities and explicitly forbids trusting a self-reported PASS boolean.
